title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
paragraphs: We reviewed the claim submitted by Northgate Imaging Center under your health plan for services provided on September 4, 2026. After review, we are unable to approve payment.
Reason for denial: The claim lacks information needed for adjudication. The diagnosis code submitted by the provider is missing or invalid. Reason code: CO-16.
The plan paid $0.00 of the $345.55 billed. The amount you may owe the provider is $345.55.

appeal.heading: Your Right to Appeal
appeal.text: You or your authorized representative may file a written appeal within 180 days of the date you receive this notice. Send it to Tamsin Health Partners, Appeals Unit, PO Box 8330, Peoria, IL 61602. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-7624.
appeal.external: After the internal appeal, you may have the right to an independent external review. Free help is available from your state's consumer assistance program.
